bestBets.overview: PRESTIGE ZERPRISE is very close to that first win. 1600m should suit and from that low draw, he might be a chance to race closer, perhaps even box seat. Not sure what happened to DETERMINATO at Bairnsdale but his 2nds either side of that run are ok for this. From the draw he should be getting a good run in transit. raceTips.comment: Unoyaself worked to the line well in a high-rating maiden at Ballarat last start behind impressive winner Quick Finish. Determinato bounced back with the blinkers on last start when second at Warracknabeal behind Cute Girl.
